name: ChampOracle
description: Simulate a campaign against synthetic personas before sending it to anyone real. The pre-flight check for outreach: getting a campaign wrong on 500 real prospects costs you those prospects and some domain reputation; getting it wrong in a simulation costs a few minutes of compute.

actions.label: Simulate Campaign
actions.description: Run a campaign against a synthetic audience built from a reality seed. Long-running — it drives the full pipeline (seed → ontology → knowledge graph → persona simulation → report), so poll get_campaign for progress rather than expecting a result inline.

campaign.description: Campaign definition: subject, body, target segment

reality_seed.description: Grounding document the personas are generated from. Richer seeds produce a denser graph and more differentiated personas.

webhook_url.description: Optional completion callback, so a DAG can wait on an event instead of polling

actions.label: Get Simulation Status
actions.description: Progress and status for a running or finished simulation. Safe to poll.

actions.label: Get Personas
actions.description: The synthetic personas generated for this campaign, with their attributes. Use to check the audience is actually representative before trusting the reactions.

actions.label: Get Simulation Report
actions.description: Aggregate reactions and findings across the persona set — the summary judgement on whether the campaign lands.

actions.label: Ask the Simulation
actions.description: Free-form question against a finished simulation, e.g. 'which persona objected to pricing and why'. This is the read that turns a report into something a DAG can branch on.

actions.label: Interview a Persona
actions.description: Question one persona in depth rather than reading aggregate output. Useful when the report says a segment rejected the message but not what would have worked.

actions.label: Predict Deliverability
actions.description: Spam and placement read on campaign copy BEFORE sending. Distinct from ChampMail's InboxKit health, which measures a mailbox after the fact — this scores the message, that scores the sender.

actions.label: List Channels
actions.description: Channels this ChampOracle deployment can simulate.

actions.label: Health Check
actions.description: Whether the ChampOracle service is reachable. Worth gating a long simulation on, since the pipeline is expensive to start and abandon.
